The <b>Mask Maker</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. He provides lore on masks and on [[Pharloom|Pharloom's]] history.

== Background ==
The Mask Maker provides masks for the bugs of [[Pharloom]], claiming their importance in giving an identity to those who do not have it.<ref>Mask Maker: "All deserve a face. A chance to be! Until I wither, for the faceless I shall provide."</ref><ref>Mask Maker: "To exist, a face is needed. It is the essential thing."</ref><ref>Mask Maker Needolin dialogue: "A mask to hide... A mask to be... Fresh faces for all... A land defined... What greater gift?"</ref> Although he is a mortal bug,<ref>Mask Maker: "Your ancient kind, vying for dominion, and us mortal bugs squashed unseen underneath."</ref>  he is aware of the history and current condition of Pharloom. He is implied to be well respected by Pharloom's bugs due to his profession as a mask maker, which bears a heavy mantle.<ref>Tipp: "A delivery deadly, dangerous, fiercably cold, for old bug up there that does need it much-much! Serves us all he does, so we serve back."</ref>

== In-game Events ==
[[Hornet (Hollow Knight)|Hornet]] encounters the Mask Maker on Mount Fay, humming to himself as he works in a secluded hut. While masked, he repeats a set of mantra-like lines talking about the importance of needing a face.

The Mask Maker can be unmasked with [[Heavy Damage]]. Once unmasked, the Mask Maker comments on the rudeness of such an action, but acknowledges Hornet's status as being related to the [[Higher Beings]], or "Old Ones," asking if Hornet plans to take on the ruler of Pharloom. When she answers in the positive, he does not seem surprised, mentioning that Hornet may have more growth yet despite having lived for countless lives.

Liquid Lacquer must be delivered to the Mask Maker for the delivery wish [[Liquid Lacquer (Wish)|Liquid Lacquer]].

{{HTalk|I had the desire to hear you lucid, Maker, though you may protest.}}<br>
Aye. Well it's no great shock to have you visit. I've felt the stirrings of our monarch, even all the way out here, the tremors of her kin brought close.<br>
You're planning a confrontation with her then? The one atop? Our great, frayed god?<br>
{{HTalk|Our meeting seems inevitable, though first I seek the strength to ensure a favourable outcome.}}<br>

| Title3_Event2 = Speaking again
| Title3_Dialogue2 = {{HTalk|You have the sight, Maker. Tell me what you see in me?}}<br>
Your mask... It reads clear enough, Old One. Watcher, hunter, monarch even, though you may reject that station.<br>
A complex visage, perhaps, yet still to my sight it looks unresolved.<br>
{{HTalk|If you see a transitional state, it is one I have accepted. My mask has remained defined through lifetimes uncounted.}}<br>
Aye. Rigid I'm sure, but your kind rarely develop evenly, and the lifetime of bugs are poor measure for one like you.<br>
Could be there's more growth awaiting you yet...
| Title3_Event3 = Revisiting, after playing the [[Threefold Melody]] to unlock the lift to [[The Cradle]] and having had the conversation above
| Title3_Dialogue3 = {{HTalk|The bugs of your land, I have watched them, climbing towards their absolution without the flicker of a thought to what it means.}}<br>
Aye. But isn't it always such for those snared to serve your higher caste?<br>
Our mortal mob did once act some defiance, unawares maybe, but successful in part, goaded towards it by Weavers' will'n all.<br>
{{HTalk|You speak of the Citadel? Its former function has failed, but I can still sense its purpose, some. It is church and cage both.}}<br>
Aye. Devised by your ancestors that monstrosity, and their wicked, clever minds. A system, or a web they'd likely call it, a way to keep their mother sealed in slumber, and themselves free to lavish in their false rule.
| Title3_Event4 = Speaking after acquiring [[Faydown Cloak]]
| Title3_Dialogue4 = Did you treat with the creature upon the summit?<br>
Your legged ancestors once found her company compelling, enough to build their chambers and their calling device at the height of this perilous peak.<br>
{{HTalk|I have paid my respects, and been granted her favour. Her down now fills my cloak, and does much to ward against the frost of these heights.}}<br>
To pass something so precious... That's a mighty gift you've been given. Seems she's thrown her lot in with you.<br>
I'd not have guessed her so opposed to our threaded monarch, but then she too must have sensed the wretched state of things, and the harsher change to come. 
| Title3_Event5 = Delivering the [[Liquid Lacquer]]
| Title3_Dialogue5 = {{HTalk|Maker, I bring a delivery from Bellhart below, lacquer for your long work.}}<br>
Ahh. Know you distort the order of things, Old One. It is a rare want of your caste to serve us mortal bugs.<br>
{{HTalk|I am not my kin, Maker. I have seen enough pain born of their dominion. As much as I may, I choose to stand apart.}}<br>
If your blood allows it so... And my thanks still for the lacquer. Pharloom's fresh faces will welcome its sheen.<br>
Have some small reward for your troubles, Old One. It's no small thing to deliver that sloshing stuff safe, 'specially all the way up here.
| Title3_Event6 = Exhausted dialogue
| Title3_Dialogue6 = Enough talk, Old One. Mine is a calling that scant allows rest.<br>
{{HTalk|Very well, Maker. I shall take my leave.}}

Mask Maker is found in the northwest part of [[Mount Fay]], accessible after acquiring the [[Faydown Cloak]].

== Trivia ==
* Mask Maker shares his name with [[Mask Maker (Hollow Knight)|a similar NPC]] from Hollow Knight. They both seem to have the same role within their respective kingdoms, and can be unmasked to reveal similar spiraling eyes.
* Though Mask Maker's Needolin dialogue does not change when unmasked, his tune and singing voice do.
* [[Mask Shard (Silksong)|Mask Shards]] in [[Wormways]], [[Blasted Steps]], and [[Bilewater]] are found with background outcrops which resemble the exterior of his hut.
